meta.method: Coarse documentation-evidence classes from the committed automated README scan. The scan records README size, heading count and section signals, but not release assets, demo images or runtime behaviour. This mapping does not change the scan record and is not a curated evidence class.

rubric.0: Never assigned automatically. Class 0 requires a manual curated review.
rubric.1: README documents both installation and usage. Demo, release assets and buildability remain unobserved.
rubric.2: README documentation exists, but installation or usage guidance was not found.
rubric.3: No usable README documentation was found by the scan.
rubric.unknown: The automated scan did not record a readable README.

limits: Scan metadata cannot establish that a project builds, runs or matches any target application.
Section signals come from README headings and keywords; they do not prove the instructions work.
Release assets, demo media and reconstruction scope were not collected for the scan.
A scan class is not comparable to a curated Class 0 review; Class 0 is never assigned here.
